answer: Issue each answer a saffron receipt that can be minted only inside a fresh island, a one-shot machine the key does not own. The island is destroyed after the text is signed, so a farm cannot reuse the setup. A key still on bare karst, with no prior passing epoch, is paid less than the cost of standing up that island. Cloning therefore buys a new machine every epoch and still earns nothing until the key has a history.
